changes.evidence: What If...? episode 20 (S3E2, 'What If... Agatha Went to Hollywood?'): Howard Stark brings Kingo in from Bollywood as co-lead of the Stark Pictures production Cosmic Queen; Kingo turns on Arishem for a three-picture deal with Stark Pictures and ends the episode at the Cosmic Queen premiere promising a sequel. Agatha's record in the same universe already has Stark Pictures. The MCU wiki lists his affiliation as Stark Pictures.

What If...? episode 21 (S3E3): Dreykov gives Alexei an undercover Red Room mission in Ohio, and Alexei complains on screen 'Typical Red Room borscht. They say they care, but do they?'. Dreykov later puts a kill order on him and a Red Room task force tries to kill him, which is the departure already recorded. His main-MCU record has the same Soviet Armed Forces then Red Room stages, and Dreykov's record in this universe has the Red Room.

What If...? episode 13 (S2E4): on Sakaar, Tony is shown reports that Pepper is now acting CEO of Stark Industries in his absence (his own company, a past group the screen tells), and he is an Avenger from the Battle of New York. The MCU wiki lists his affiliations as Stark Industries and the Avengers. Keyed the same way as Hank Pym's past S.H.I.E.L.D. stage in this batch.

owner_calls.question: Rogers Hood founds and leads an outlaw band with Bucky and Scott Lang in 1602 (they rob Loki's carriage and hide in his treehouse) before joining Carter's team. Should that band get a stage before The Avengers, and under what name? The MCU wiki calls it the 'Merry Men', but it sources that name to a companion book, not the episode.
options: Add a stage 'The Merry Men' (What If...? S2) before The Avengers
Leave as is (no screen name for the band)
owner_calls.evidence: What If...? episode 17 (S2E8): Rogers Hood, Bucky Barnes and Scott Lang rob Loki's carriage as his band of thieves and later join Carter to storm the castle.

owner_calls.question: After going on the run, Alexei settles in the US as a gym teacher (under the name Bob Toledo), and Bill Foster finds him at that job. The school is not named. Should this employer get a stage?
options: No stage (a minor job seen once, school unnamed)
Add a school employer stage between Independent and S.H.I.E.L.D.
owner_calls.evidence: What If...? episode 21 (S3E3): the closing scene, twenty-one years later. Alexei works as a gym teacher, and Foster returns his shield and offers him a S.H.I.E.L.D. job.

owner_calls.question: Sam runs a veterans' support group in Washington, D.C., and invites Bruce Banner (A:by-bruce-mech), who attends it. Does a support group count as a group (as Veterans Affairs does for the main Sam), with Sam as its leader and Bruce as a member?
options: Add 'Veterans Affairs' (or the support group) as a first stage for Sam only
Add it for Sam and for Bruce (Bruce then leaves it after his gamma accident)
owner_calls.evidence: What If...? episode 19 (S3E1): Sam meets Bruce while jogging and invites him to his support group, where Bruce opens up about the Hulk. The MCU wiki lists the 'District of Columbia Support Group' (Sam) and the same group 'formerly' (Bruce).
